dict.string: SW-DLT 🛑 DEV 5.0 🛑 Official release on GitHub, avoid unknown sources!

SETTINGS ^^^^ Change the above settings as needed by your usage:
uninstall: this will uninstall all utilities used by the shortcut. Useful if the shortcut is being removed without deleting a-Shell. Default value is 'False'
logging: allows the shortcut to write logs to a local file. Logs are not transmitted at any point and are only useful for troubleshooting issue reports. Default is 'False.' Only enable if reporting an issue.
subtitles: this will enable or disable the embedding of subtitles from videos. The language fetched is defined using "sub_lang" key. Default is 'False'

==== END OF USER SETTINGS ==== ⚠️ Do not edit anything beyond this point, or the shortcut could stop working!
SHORTCUT INITIALIZATION
Warning! this process will uninstall all local files, packages, and any resource used by SW-DLT. Reinstalling will be blocked until the setting is reverted.
SW-DLT has been successfully uninstalled. You can safely delete this shortcut or begin a new installation process by enabling the setting.

WORKSPACE="$HOME/Documents/￼" FLAG="$WORKSPACE/.installed"
if [ ! -f $FLAG ] then echo "INCOMPLETE_INSTALL" fi

SW-DLT requires additional packages which have not been found. By continuing with the installation, these resources will be downloaded remotely. Would you like to continue? (installation path is: Files app -> a-Shell folder -> ￼)
sleep 1 clear hideKeyboard cd $HOME/Documents/￼ source venv/bin/activate python SW_DLT.py deactivate clear cd

LATEST_VERSION="https://net00-1.github.io/SW-DLT/api/updates/latest.json" WORKSPACE="$HOME/Documents/￼" LAST_CHECK_TS="$WORKSPACE/update_last_check.txt" CURRENT_DATE=$(date +%s) CURRENT_VERSION="￼"
if [ ! -f $LAST_CHECK_TS ] then echo 0 > $LAST_CHECK_TS fi
TS_DATE=$(cat $LAST_CHECK_TS) DATE_DIFF=$(($CURRENT_DATE - $TS_DATE))
if [ $((DATE_DIFF / 86400)) -ge 1 ] then VER_CHECK=$(curl -sL $LATEST_VERSION) date +%s > $LAST_CHECK_TS if [ "$CURRENT_VERSION" != $(echo $VER_CHECK | jq -r ".version") ] then echo $VER_CHECK fi fi

WORKSPACE="$HOME/Documents/￼" TICKET="$WORKSPACE/SW_DLT_DL_ticket.json"
if [ -f $TICKET ] then cat $TICKET fi

Description

SW-DLT ("Shortcuts Wrapper for -DL Tools") is a shortcut that makes using yt-dlp and gallery-dl quick and simple. It is powered by a-Shell, a powerful terminal emulator for iPhone & iPad
